episode_summary: Case Blackwell and Jeff Ripple opened with Microsoft layoffs, election polling, and a banana-costumed nurse hero before Hype Train derailed into algebraic blame. A green skeleton Munch debated Crum on Halloween's purpose while referencing Rennerton progression, Brandon gamed through maternal door interventions and a garage egg-dying toilet, Jeb Nogget patted a 'patent more pup' and triggered a bilingual profanity trap, and Trent reviewed ventriloquist horror and Rings of Power under parole supervision. The broadcast closed with Case announcing his engagement to Kendelle via hate sock and raiding British streamer Harry Hardy.
